Headline: Forest Park-bound Blue Line Delays
ShortDescription: Forest Park-bound Blue Line trains are running with residual delays following an earlier door problem at Clark/Lake. Service is resuming, allow extra time.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Forest Park-bound Blue Line trains are running with residual delays following an earlier door problem at Clark/Lake.

Some trains and platforms may be busier than usual as crews work to restore normal service.

Trains are moving and normal service is being restored.

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: #9 Ashland Temporary Southbound Reroute near Ashland/Wilson
ShortDescription: Southbound #9 Ashland buses are temporarily rerouted: due to a street blockage near Ashland/Wilson.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Southbound #9 Ashland buses are temporarily rerouted via Ashland, Wilson, Clark, Montrose, and Ashland, then resume their normal route, due to a street blockage near Ashland/Wilson.

Northbound buses are not affected.

Allow extra travel time.
